descricao: The design of the level bears an extremely loose connection to late Victorian indoor markets, with various modifications from later decades such as halogen bulbs for lights,2 modern metal shutters on stores, cash registers, cash machines, and other small modifications and accessories that were only made after the Industrial Revolution. Each room in 82 is a rather large, though heavily furnished, room with a floor of rather cold stone bricks. They can follow various inclines, and the ground ascends/descends as if it follows a natural landscape.
entidades: Smilers, Hounds, Bursters, Reviooks, Animations, Dentists (citadas na página)
